# Matthew St. Germain

> Senior Unity engineer and client lead in Montreal, open to remote roles with US teams. Twelve years shipping games and engine tooling; for the last two, building multi-agent AI systems that test, fix and ship games.

Every figure below is also on the linked pages. Contact: mattstger@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthew-st-germain-10368bba/

## Key results
- Storycraft (live-ops iOS game, Aug 2025 – Oct 2026, Senior Unity Developer, owned the game client): crash rate cut 73%, from 5.5% to 1.5% of sessions. Also built many of the game's player-facing features from design specs (quests, currency and progression, leaderboards, player profiles, interior rooms, object manipulation, an announcement tool, UI screens).
- An overnight test runner: agents run unattended for up to 12 hours (usually 8 pm to 3–8 am) and do about a day of developer work per night (best nights about 14 tickets) on a fixed Claude Max plan, under hard limits: no production access, no merges to shared branches.
- A multi-editor runner: 3 Unity editors per developer, each with its own agent, environment and backend, a task queue, a resource manager and a CLI bridge into the editor.
- Weekly pre-release testing cut from 8–16 developer-hours (2–4 developers, about 4 hours) to about 4 (one developer reviewing an overnight run).
- Release Desk: headless Claude turns each weekly release's commits into release notes, a test plan and the affected CMS values; a few hours of separate prep tasks became a few minutes of review.
- About 40% of the client team's tracked runtime C# additions, about twice the next-largest contributor.

## Work history
- 2025 – 2026 · Storycraft · Senior Unity Developer (owned the game client)
- 2025 · Roam (US, remote) · Client Lead (Unity/AI engine): engine where AI builds playable 3D iPhone games through tools, since iOS forbids runtime code generation
- 2016 – 2024 · Pansimula (own studio) · Founder / Lead Developer: Galactic Thunderdome, 600+ destructible objects at 60 fps on Steam Deck
- 2017 – 2022 · Legends of Learning · Game Developer (contract): five educational games designed and built by Matthew (Grow Hop designed with the team); Educagent 530,000+ plays
- 2018 – 2023 · ISI, private college in Montreal · Head of English Game Development Program
- Earlier: Playtika (World Series of Poker), Ludia (Family Feud), CAE, VIA Rail

## Skills
Unity, C#, C++, Python, TypeScript; software architecture and design patterns; Claude Code, multi-agent orchestration, MCP, agent tooling and editor bridges; iOS, Android, Xcode, TestFlight; Sentry, BigQuery, Amplitude, AppsFlyer; multithreading, async/await, Job System, compute shaders, ECS, IL2CPP; CI/CD, Docker, automated and unit testing; Steamworks.
